svg.title: Illustration in Botbench's own words: a task, Make add in calc.py return the sum, is handed to Claude Code, which works in a separate copy on the branch botbench/studio-mac/run-7/task-7. 1 of 1 check passed. Codex's review is shown as a model's opinion, not a check. Under the changed file, calc.py, Botbench warns: office-mac's open pull request #12 also changes calc.py, so the two may conflict when both are merged. Your decision: Reject or Accept. An annotation beside the warning, not part of the screen, says: Another workbench is changing the same file. You find out before either is merged.
